_source: The real order lifecycle — OrderStatus values the backend moves an order through: PLACED → VENDOR_ACCEPTED → DELIVERY_ASSIGNED → DELIVERY_PICKED → IN_TRANSIT → DELIVERED. Payment is online: cash on delivery is a feature flag (feature.payment.cod_enabled) seeded off.

items.title: Choose what you need
items.body: Browse shops near you and add to your cart.

items.title: Place your order
items.body: Pay securely online through Razorpay, with every fee shown before you do.

items.title: The shop accepts
items.body: A verified local vendor confirms and packs it.

items.title: A rider accepts it
items.body: Offered to a rider near the shop, who chooses to take it — then tracked to your door.
